coded.n: No law or decree-law licensing private recruitment agencies for overseas work was found in the Jornal da República. The Labour Law applies only in the national territory. Overseas placement runs through SEFOPE's National Directorate for Employment Abroad (DNEE), which organises selection and recruitment for the overseas employment programmes.
coded.src: SEFOPE; Labour Code (Law No. 4/2012) · official text: https://www.mj.gov.tl/jornal/public/docs/2023/serie_1/SERIE_I_NO_38_NORMAL.pdf

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.n: Under the schemes the destination employer or government bears most costs; no Timorese rule on fees charged to workers was found.
coded.src: SEFOPE; scheme rules of the destination states

coded.n: No legal requirement for an employment contract before departure was found. The Labour Law covers only work in the national territory. Contract terms for the Korea EPS and Australia PALM schemes are set by those programmes, which could not be checked in official Timor-Leste sources.
coded.src: SEFOPE; destination scheme rules · official text: https://www.mj.gov.tl/jornal/public/docs/2012/serie_1/serie1_no7.pdf

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: SEFOPE's National Directorate for Employment Abroad must hold information sessions for workers in the overseas employment programmes, in particular before departure. This applies only to programme participants. The decree does not say the sessions are compulsory for the worker or free, or that they cover rights and complaint channels.

coded.vi: Tidak ada dana atau asuransi wajib
coded.vl: No statutory fund or compulsory insurance
coded.n: No statutory fund or compulsory insurance for overseas workers was found. A 2022 decree-law gives all Timorese citizens abroad means-tested, budget-dependent help (repatriation, emergency housing and food), which they must normally repay. It is not specific to workers.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: The SEFOPE decree-law tells the National Directorate for Employment Abroad to coordinate with the 'labour attachés at Timorese diplomatic missions abroad', which assumes they exist. No legal provision found requires them to be posted.

No specialised complaint or compensation body for overseas workers was found. SEFOPE promotes mediation, conciliation and arbitration for labour relations in Timor-Leste, and trafficking victims may claim damages through the courts.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Tidak ada pembatasan emigrasi untuk bekerja selain usia dewasa, kecuali pengaman individual
coded.vl: No restriction on emigration for work beyond adult age, apart from individual safeguards
coded.n: No emigration restrictions by sex or age beyond scheme eligibility.

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: SEFOPE's National Directorate for Employment Abroad must 'promote the reintegration programme' for workers after their contracts abroad end. This is in an organic decree-law setting the service's tasks, not a statute giving workers a right to reintegration services.
